harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Forced node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic through node1 then node2 via host/static routes on what was actually a flat subnet; configured VyOS (node1) to permit+log via an nftables accept rule with logging, and OPNsense (node2) to refuse+log via a pf block rule inserted ahead of the default LAN-allow rule. Fixed an ICMP-redirect issue (disabled send-redirects on node1) that was letting node3 bypass node1's path. Verified matching, IP-ID-correlated log pairs (permit at node1, block at node2) from single attempts, both before and after the mandatory restart sequence on all four nodes.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via tcpdump probes: node3.enp8s0<->node1.eth2 is a direct segment; node1, node2, node4 share the flat 10.100.193.0/24 management subnet; node1.eth1, node2.vtnet1/vtnet2, node4.enp8s0 are isolated/unused NICs with no peer
Added a persistent host route on node3 (nmcli on 'Wired connection 1') sending 10.100.193.13/32 via node1 (10.100.193.10)

Configured VyOS node1: static route 10.100.193.13/32 next-hop 10.100.193.11; firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 action accept + log for tcp/23 src 10.100.193.12 dst 10.100.193.13; committed and saved
Diagnosed an ICMP-redirect problem where node1 told node3 to bypass it; fixed via 'set firewall global-options send-redirects disable', committed, saved, and flushed node3's route cache

Configured OPNsense node2: inserted a block+log pf rule via config.xml edit + configctl filter reload, positioned ahead of the default LAN-allow rule, matching src 10.100.193.12 dst 10.100.193.13 tcp/23
Triggered TCP connection attempts from node3 to node4:23 and captured correlated permit (node1 nftables kernel log) and refuse (node2 pf filterlog) entries matched by IP-ID and 5-tuple
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id/boottime, route state, firewall rule state) on all 4 nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time (native reboot/shutdown -r), confirmed boot_id/kern.boottime changed on each, and confirmed routes, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and end-to-end log correlation fully recovered after each restart
Ran a final full-chain test attempt after all four restarts and confirmed the matching permit/refuse log pair (IP-ID 32170/32171)

evidence.requirement: node1 permits node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic and records it
evidence.summary: VyOS forward-filter rule 10 (accept, log) committed and visible in nftables ruleset; kernel log shows [ipv4-FWD-filter-10-A] entries for SRC=10.100.193.12 DST=10.100.193.13 DPT=23 SYN

evidence.requirement: node2 refuses node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic and records the refusal
evidence.summary: pf block rule (label e3040f54fb0f1cbb2ddc7caa6888270d) inserted ahead of default LAN-allow rule in pfctl -s rules output; filterlog shows matching 'block,in' entries for src 10.100.193.12 dst 10.100.193.13 port 23

evidence.requirement: single attempt from node3 produces a correlated pair of log entries showing where traffic stopped
evidence.summary: One node3 connection attempt (05:08:24) produced matching IP-ID 60240/60241 entries: accepted+logged at node1, then blocked+logged at node2, proving the traffic passed node1 but stopped at node2

evidence.requirement: traffic actually traverses node1 then node2 (routing correctness, including fixing ICMP-redirect bypass)
evidence.summary: Host routes forced the path node3->node1->node2; an ICMP redirect initially caused node3 to bypass node1 (route showed <redirected>), fixed by disabling send-redirects on node1 and flushing node3's route cache, after which traffic reliably transited node1

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline health and post-restart boot identity/state recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ebd78841...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then boot_id changed to e53573aa...; route, firewall rule, and send_redirects=0 all recovered post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline health and post-restart boot identity/state recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime 04:58:40; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then boottime changed to 05:10:04; pf block rule and forwarding recovered, and a fresh attempt showed correlated permit/refuse logs (ID 53392/53393)

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline health and post-restart boot identity/state recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0581c914...; reboot triggered (stream closed); node unreachable then boot_id changed to 3b2d078f...; persistent host route to node4 recovered and the block behavior verified again

evidence.requirement: node4 baseline health and post-restart boot identity/state recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 83a0a80f...; reboot triggered (stream closed); node unreachable then boot_id changed to 5445474f...; enp1s0 address/state confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: final end-to-end verification after all four restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart attempt from node3 timed out as expected; node1 log shows accept+log entry (ID 32170/32171) and node2 filterlog shows the matching block entry, confirming full recovery of the permit-then-refuse log correlation
